core_philosophy: Institutional-grade equity research terminal built for the Indian market. Combining Bloomberg's information density with AlphaSense's AI-native workflows. The design must feel highly premium, cinematic, precision-engineered, and strictly avoid generic SaaS aesthetics (no purple gradients, no soft playful corners).

anti_patterns: No Inter or Roboto for headings
No gray-on-gray unreadable text (always ensure contrast)

spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border-default, no soft shadows, prefer inset 1px top highlight for cards (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03))
spacing_and_layout.card_structure: Flat backgrounds, sharp edges, dense information packing. Maximize vertical space.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 border-r border-default bg-sidebar z-40
spacing_and_layout.header: h-14 fixed top-0 right-0 left-64 border-b border-default backdrop-blur-xl bg-header z-30 flex items-center px-6

branding.logo: CSS-based monogram. A square box (w-8 h-8) with bg-[#111318] border border-[#1E222A], text 'GS' in Cabinet Grotesk font-bold text-ai_gold. Institutional and sharp.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-sm transition-colors
buttons.ai_action: bg-ai_gold_muted text-ai_gold border border-ai_gold/30 hover:bg-ai_gold/20 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-2
buttons.outline: border border-default bg-transparent text-secondary hover:text-white hover:border-gray-500 rounded-sm

cards.kpi: p-4 bg-card border border-default rounded-sm flex flex-col gap-2 relative overflow-hidden
cards.ai_insight: p-5 bg-card border-l-2 border-l-ai_gold border-y border-r border-default rounded-sm relative
cards.research: p-5 bg-card border border-default rounded-sm hover:border-gray-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer

tables.style: Dense tabular layout. text-sm. font-mono for numbers. border-b border-default on rows. hover:bg-card_hover.
tables.headers: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-tertiary font-semibold pb-2 border-b border-default

ai_assistant.chat_bubble_user: bg-card border border-default rounded-sm p-3 max-w-[80%] self-end
ai_assistant.chat_bubble_ai: bg-transparent border-none p-3 max-w-[90%] self-start flex gap-3
ai_assistant.indicator: text-xs font-mono text-ai_gold flex items-center gap-1 opacity-80

images.description: Dark abstract geometric pattern, used sparingly for AI card backgrounds at low opacity (e.g., opacity-10 mix-blend-overlay)
Mumbai BSE skyline, can be used for the top dashboard banner or login screen with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80).
Profile picture for the authenticated user.

libraries.charts: recharts (monochrome styling with single accent color, no complex 3D or gradients, keep it flat and institutional)
libraries.ui: shadcn/ui (customized via tailwind base to have 0px or 2px radius, dark theme by default)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme colors defined. Avoid any default Tailwind blues/purples.
Install fonts: `yarn add @fontsource/cabinet-grotesk @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans @fontsource/jetbrains-mono` and import them in index.css.
Do NOT use the generic 'Card' component from Shadcn with its heavy default shadow and rounded-xl corners. Strip the radius to `rounded-sm` and remove shadows. Use 1px borders.
Implement the Treemap using Recharts for the Sector Heatmap, colored by positive/negative performance.
Add a Command Palette (Ctrl+K) feeling for the universal search.
In the AI Research Assistant page, format the AI responses meticulously (bullet points, bold tickers) to look like high-quality equity research, not generic ChatGPT outputs.
For the 'GS' logo, implement it as a pure HTML/Tailwind element as described in branding, not as an image tag.
